nodes.description: Privileged owner address of the BotProtected/Standard contracts, set to tx.origin in the Standard constructor.
Address of the Ferrum bot protection contract invoked via low-level call in the checkBots modifier.
Computed Uniswap/Pancake pair address used inside the bot protection call.
Constructor assigning the bot protection address.
Modifier performing an unchecked low-level call to the bot protection contract before the decorated function body.
Low-level stopTheBots.call with abi.encodeWithSelector inside the checkBots modifier; return success is only required to be true.
Caller-controlled address used for balance, allowance and owner checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
Origin of the transaction used to set owner and infinite allowances in the constructor.
Public mapping of account balances, mutated by transferFrom and list.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances, mutated by approve, transferFrom and the constructor.
Total token supply constant-initialized to 100,000,000 * 1e18.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for addLiquidityETH in list().
Wrapped BNB address used to derive the liquidity pair in the constructor.
Constructor setting owner from tx.origin, computing uniPair and granting infinite allowances.
Payable transfer entrypoint delegating to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Payable transferFrom guarded by the checkBots modifier; mutates allowance and balances.
Payable allowance setter writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address a with bytes b.
Internal pure helper computing the deterministic pair address via CREATE2 hashing.
Owner-only function that mints balances, adds liquidity, calls the bot protection contract and airdrops to recipients; uses block.timestamp as deadline.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary external code in the storage context of the contract.
Low-level stopTheBots.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0xd5eaf4c3, _tos)) in list(); return value is ignored.
External payable call routerForUniswap.addLiquidityETH with msg.value and a timestamp-derived deadline.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, source account of the transfer.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, destination account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, amount moved.
Parameter a of delegate(), target address of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate(), raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
Parameter _numList of list(), liquidity/mint amount.
Constructor parameter _botProtection stored into stopTheBots.
Parameter _spender of approve(), address granted the allowance.
Parameter _value of approve(), allowance amount granted.

edges.reason: BotProtected constructor writes the _botProtection argument into the stopTheBots state variable.
Constructor parameter _botProtection feeds the assignment to stopTheBots.
The checkBots modifier always performs the low-level stopTheBots call before executing the guarded body.
stopTheBots state variable is the target address of the low-level call in the modifier.
uniPair is ABI-encoded into the calldata of the stopTheBots.call in the modifier.
transferFrom is decorated with the checkBots modifier, so the modifier executes on entry.
transferFrom parameter _from is forwarded into the checkBots modifier call.
transferFrom parameter _to is forwarded into the checkBots modifier call.
transferFrom parameter _value is forwarded into the checkBots modifier call.
Parameter _from is the source account consumed by transferFrom balance logic.
Parameter _to is the destination account consumed by transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the amount consumed by transferFrom.
msg.sender selects the spender whose allowance is checked and decremented in transferFrom.
transferFrom directly mutates the balanceOf mapping for _from and _to.
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping when msg.sender is not _from.
transfer() delegates its entire execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of the delegated transferFrom call.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
Parameter _spender is used as the key of the allowance mapping in approve.
Parameter _value is the allowance amount stored by approve.
msg.sender must equal owner for delegate() to proceed, gating arbitrary delegatecall execution.
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender to authorize delegate().
delegate() executes the unsafe delegatecall to attacker-controlled address after the owner check.
Parameter a is the target address of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Parameter b is the raw calldata executed by the delegatecall.
The Standard constructor assigns owner = tx.origin, making a phishing-prone origin the privileged account.
Constructor writes tx.origin into the owner state variable.
Constructor stores the pairForPancake result into uniPair.
Constructor writes infinite allowances for the router and tx.origin into the allowance mapping.
Constructor invokes the internal pairForPancake helper to derive the pair address.
wBNB address is one of the tokens hashed inside pairForPancake.
list() requires msg.sender == owner and also credits balanceOf[msg.sender].
owner state variable gates execution of list().
list() performs a low-level call to the bot protection contract with the recipient array.
stopTheBots address is the call target inside list().
block.timestamp is used to compute the addLiquidityETH deadline (timestamp dependence).
list() calls the external router addLiquidityETH with msg.value.
routerForUniswap is the external contract invoked by addLiquidityETH.
Parameter _numList is the liquidity amount and balanceOf[address(this)] value in list().
list() writes arbitrarily large values into the balanceOf mapping for recipients.
approve writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender and _spender.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from is only used as the source account inside transferFrom and has no independent meaning.
Parameter _to is only used as the destination account inside transferFrom.
Parameter _value is only used as the transferred amount inside transferFrom.
Parameter a is only consumed as the delegatecall target inside the unsafe delegate operation.
Parameter b is only consumed as the delegatecall calldata inside the unsafe delegate operation.
Parameter _numList is only consumed as the liquidity amount inside list().
Parameter _botProtection is only used to initialize stopTheBots in the BotProtected constructor.
Parameter _spender is only consumed as the allowance key inside approve.
Parameter _value is only consumed as the allowance amount inside approve.
